source.title: Keystone metro cost factor (BLS OEWS wages, see README cost method)

factor.note: MSA 12420 Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX: labour index L=0.905, materials M=1.0. 5/5 trades (OEWS May 2024 via O*NET Texas local-wages search extracts). Ratios to US: 47-2031 0.837; 47-2111 0.947; 47-2152 0.989; 47-2061 0.843; 49-9021 0.984. L = 0.905; factor = 0.40*0.905 + 0.60*1.00 = 0.96. M=1.00 (default, no public citable reason to adjust).

cost.method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.

plainLanguage: Cedar Park uses the 2021 International Residential Code, energy code and plumbing code (effective June 2022) and the 2020 electrical code. Most new single-family lots are in the SU (Semi-Urban Residential) district: lots at least 8,250 sq ft and 75 ft wide, setbacks of 25 ft front, 10 ft sides, 15 ft on a street side and 20 ft rear, homes up to 35 ft tall and at least 1,500 sq ft. A front porch or saving a protected tree can earn up to 5 ft of setback relief. Heritage trees (26 inches or more) cost $450 per inch to remove, so plan around them. Parts of the city are over the Edwards Aquifer, where state rules apply - usually already handled by your subdivision's approved plan. Water and sewer impact fees are about $6,300 per home.
